identity.title: First Real Non-Wallet Alpha Evidence Seed
identity.objective: Implement one manual foreground operator that, after separate explicit runtime activation, performs at most one controlled Hermes v0.21.3 public-web research child launch for the frozen NWS daily-rain research program, recaptures and revalidates the full research draft tool-side, obtains one Side13 result-state decision, and appends exactly one canonical non-wallet Alpha source/candidate/family/episode lineage to a dedicated local registry. Negative and inconclusive results are preserved. No QualificationCandidate, qualification decision, strategy, paper, execution, live, credential, scheduler, Gate-C or capital authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-ALPHA-REAL-01. The manual operator, focused tests, contract/status/spec artifacts and bounded repo-truth edits disappear. Existing Alpha Factory, Hermes runtime, AF1, QualificationCandidate, qualification gate, WP170/WP172/WP173 and trading surfaces remain unchanged. Runtime evidence under ignored local_data is not tracked code and grants no downstream authority.

api_matrix.reason: The package adds one manual operator surface under tools/alpha and no new src API.

items.before: No governed operator exists for creating the first genuine non-wallet Alpha lineage from controlled public-web research, and merged ValidatedResearchDraft does not retain the substantive research lists a ResearchEpisode needs.
items.after: One manual foreground operator with commands prepare, verify-local, run-real, verify-run, build-review-bundle, verify-review, finalize-alpha and verify-final; a tool-side capture/delegation backend; full-draft revalidation; one bounded research-child launch; append-only Alpha persistence; sanitized evidence output.
items.compatibility_requirement: Consumes merged run_controlled_hermes_research, ExternalHermesCliBackend, capture_final_response, validate_research_draft, build_research_run_request, DEFAULT_HERMES_INVOCATION_POLICY, the four Alpha builders and the Alpha registry APIs unchanged; no src/** change.

semantic_fields.reason: The operator crosses a real provider/public-web boundary and creates canonical research evidence, so request literals, invocation bounds, capture/revalidation, review binding, Alpha constants and registry behavior are frozen.

items.required_rule: The research request is built only by merged build_research_run_request from the exact Section 4 literals (research_question, research_objective, research_category fundamental, public_market_context, scope tokens, source types, max_sources 12, max_wall_seconds 300, max_output_bytes 1000000, cost 5, openai-codex, gpt-5.6-sol, human_review_required true, merged NON_AUTHORITY_NOTICE). Expected request_id hermesresearchrequest:sha256:efca8c27a92b32282cac6bee0a7a6d2455da590bdc54f6b883bfc16308bfdf2d.
items.validation_rule: prepare and run-real rebuild the request and require the exact expected request_id; any mismatch is PRE_RUNTIME_STOP REQUEST_IDENTITY_MISMATCH with zero launches.

items.required_rule: run_controlled_hermes_research with DEFAULT_HERMES_INVOCATION_POLICY (policy_id hermesinvocationpolicy:sha256:18b8f788fa436712b377c81b10bdbd594cdb7afb3844fcc8559fde3b28c25e81), context_mode False, web-only. Controller executions max 1; research-child launches max 1; automatic controller rerun, replacement run, content/schema rerun, provider/model fallback and backend fallback/rescue all 0. Internal same-provider Hermes recovery and multiple provider API requests inside the one child are not additional runs. USD 5 is the accepted reported estimated-cost ceiling, not invoice-attested and not a pre-spend limit.
items.validation_rule: The capture backend refuses any second invoke; receipt transport_attempt_count must equal 1 after a launch; api_call_count is reported and never treated as a violation by itself.
items.safe_output: counts, policy id, receipt id and closed terminal only

items.required_rule: Executable C:\Users\dersu\polymarket-h1-runtime\hermes-agent-v0.21.3\.venv\Scripts\hermes.exe and dedicated home C:\Users\dersu\polymarket-alpha-real-01\hermes-home are pinned. The AF1 and H1 homes are not reused. Home credential setup is human-only at checkpoint HUMAN_CREDENTIAL_SETUP_REQUIRED; the operator never reads, creates, edits or echoes credential content.
items.validation_rule: Before any launch: executable exists, is_safe_research_home true, is_clean_research_home_control_plane true, offline version probe reports 0.21.3 and offline startup probe exits 0; missing home is HUMAN_CREDENTIAL_SETUP_REQUIRED; every failure is non-consuming PRE_RUNTIME_STOP.
items.safe_output: pinned paths, boolean checks and closed stop code only

items.required_rule: run-real requires the exact prepare-written activation envelope SHA-256 named in Karl's runtime authorization, the acknowledgement I_AUTHORIZE_EXACT_S10_ALPHA_REAL_01_RUNTIME_ENVELOPE and the credential-setup confirmation I_CONFIRM_S10_ALPHA_REAL_01_HERMES_HOME_CREDENTIAL_SETUP_COMPLETE. The attempt is consumed only when the capture backend durably creates the attempt sentinel immediately before delegating invoke.
items.validation_rule: Wrong or missing envelope digest, acknowledgement, confirmation, head, workspace state or policy is PRE_RUNTIME_STOP with zero launches and no sentinel; an existing sentinel rejects run-real as ATTEMPT_ALREADY_CONSUMED.
items.safe_output: envelope digest, closed stop code, consumed yes/no

items.required_rule: After RESEARCH_DRAFT_VALIDATED, the operator applies merged capture_final_response to the exact captured stdout, re-runs merged validate_research_draft with the receipt request_id, max_sources 12 and context_mode False, and requires equality with the controller validated_draft on request_id, research_summary, confidence_label, source_references, source_urls and falsification_checks_performed. Only then it builds FULL_DRAFT_PROJECTION from the validated JSON. Mismatch is RUNTIME_FAILURE DRAFT_REVALIDATION_MISMATCH.
items.validation_rule: Only the canonical projection and its SHA-256 plus the sanitized receipt are persisted; raw stdout, stderr, environment and credentials are never persisted or printed.
items.safe_output: projection SHA-256, receipt id, request id

items.required_rule: Side13 supplies one immutable decision file with exactly the Section 11 keys, binding the exact projection SHA-256, review bundle SHA-256, Hermes receipt id and request id, and exactly one result_state among RESEARCH_SUPPORTIVE, NO_EDGE_CURRENTLY, HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFIED, DATA_INSUFFICIENT, WATCH_FOR_CHANGE. It cannot edit any research content. The operator has no default state.
items.validation_rule: Missing, malformed, extra-key, wrong-binding or unsupported decision rejects with no append; a state whose required projection list is empty stops REVIEW_STATE_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH.
items.safe_output: closed result state and binding digests

items.required_rule: Candidate, family and episode inputs use the exact Section 12 constants; expected candidate id alphacandidate:sha256:2d1523c8086acf536ad07512e1eaffed9cb9405b65e83c87b89b40ba77ee3add and family id alphafamily:sha256:136000bd56f2fc27cf490cf675ddf2715b0acfc1ee934aa5cdf2579925c208d8. Episode lists are copied verbatim from the projection; confidence_label from the projection; result_state from the decision; producer_receipt_ref and the only deterministic_evidence_ref are the receipt id; research_as_of is receipt end_utc.
items.validation_rule: Builders must return ALPHA_RECORD_VALID and derived candidate/family ids must equal the expected ids; any rejection stops ALPHA_BUILD_REJECTED with no append.
items.safe_output: content-addressed ids and closed status only

items.required_rule: Sources come only from the projection in draft order; exact duplicate (url, title, source_class) tuples keep the first occurrence. Class map official OFFICIAL, news NEWS, reference REFERENCE, public_market_data PUBLIC_MARKET_DATA, academic OTHER_PUBLIC, other_public OTHER_PUBLIC; kind PUBLIC_HTTPS; locator exact url; title exact; observed_at receipt end_utc; content_sha256 null; provenance is the frozen prefix plus receipt id. A source the Alpha builder rejects is excluded with its index and error code.
items.validation_rule: Zero usable sources stops FINALIZE_NO_USABLE_SOURCE with no append; no title, url, hash or timestamp is invented.
items.safe_output: source ids, counts and excluded indexes with codes

items.required_rule: One dedicated registry at local_data/s10_alpha_real_01/attempt-01/alpha_registry.sqlite3. Before append the operator loads and verifies it; if its record-id set is empty it appends the full batch atomically; if it equals the exact expected batch id set it returns IDEMPOTENT_FINALIZED_SUCCESS and appends nothing; any other content stops ALPHA_FINALIZATION_CONFLICT. After append it reloads and verifies chain, head, ids and counts.
items.validation_rule: The merged registry accepts a second divergent episode for the same candidate/family, so the operator exact-set pre-check is mandatory and tested.
items.safe_output: ids, counts and head entry hash only

items.required_rule: prepare inventories repo-root local_data read-only: every file with SQLite header and application id 1464877425 outside the dedicated path is loaded read-only and verified; the expected candidate/family with a unique current RESEARCH_SUPPORTIVE leaf stops ALREADY_SATISFIED_EXISTING_ALPHA; the same mechanism key or novelty fingerprint with other ids, a non-supportive leaf, or an unverifiable registry stops EXISTING_ALPHA_CONFLICT. s10_gate_af1 and s10_gate_h1 files are digested and must be unchanged at verify-final.
items.validation_rule: Inventory stops make zero launches and do not consume the attempt.
items.safe_output: relative paths, digests and closed stop code only

items.required_rule: Only a verified unique current ResearchEpisode with result_state RESEARCH_SUPPORTIVE for the expected candidate/family, or verified ALREADY_SATISFIED_EXISTING_ALPHA, makes S10-QUAL-REAL-01 eligible to be drafted; every other result preserves evidence and keeps real qualification blocked.
items.validation_rule: Status fragment, project status, repo truth and final evidence agree with the verified registry leaf state.

items.required_rule: The operator imports and calls no QualificationCandidate, qualification gate, WP170/WP172/WP173, paper, execution, live, OMS, risk, credential, scheduler or repo Polymarket product API client code; Hermes web-only reads of public HTTPS Polymarket pages are untrusted evidence, not repo API calls.
items.validation_rule: Static import/call-path test and runtime monkeypatch guards prove unreachability.

identity_derivations.reason: All request, receipt, source, candidate, family and episode identities are produced by merged canonical Hermes/Alpha code; the projection digest is plain SHA-256 over merged canonical_json_bytes and introduces no new content-addressing algorithm.

state_transitions.reason: RUNTIME package separates deterministic package readiness, Karl implementation authority and later explicit real-runtime activation.

examples.reason: Focused operator tests with the merged FakeHermesBackend behind the capture backend are the executable oracle.

evidence_plan.reason: Evidence covers zero-launch preflight, one-launch bounds, full-draft capture/revalidation, review binding, Alpha construction, registry idempotency, inventory, authority boundaries, status truth, readiness and publication.

items.expected_result: wrong head, workspace, executable, home, version, startup, policy, provider, model, request id, envelope digest, acknowledgement or credential confirmation each stop PRE_RUNTIME_STOP with zero invokes and no sentinel
capture backend refuses a second invoke, sentinel is created exactly once before delegation, second run-real rejects ATTEMPT_ALREADY_CONSUMED and no replacement, fallback or content rerun path exists
probe calls delegate unchanged and invoke returns the identical HermesInvocationOutcome object whose stdout is bounded by the merged backend max_stdout_bytes
matching revalidation yields the projection; any divergence of the six retained fields yields RUNTIME_FAILURE DRAFT_REVALIDATION_MISMATCH and no projection or Alpha append
workspace files contain the canonical projection, its SHA-256 and sanitized receipt only; raw stdout, stderr, environment values and credential-like strings never appear in files or console output

missing, malformed, extra-key, wrong projection digest, wrong bundle digest, wrong receipt id, wrong request id or unsupported state rejects; no default state exists; decision cannot alter any research field
each of the five states with its required projection list empty stops REVIEW_STATE_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH with no append
each state produces a valid ResearchEpisode whose result_state equals the decision and whose lists equal the projection verbatim, mapped to the correct terminal

exact six-entry class map, first-occurrence exact-tuple dedup, content_sha256 null, receipt end_utc observed_at, excluded builder rejections recorded, zero usable sources stops FINALIZE_NO_USABLE_SOURCE
frozen request literals reproduce the expected request_id and frozen candidate/family constants reproduce the expected candidate and family ids through merged builders
first finalize appends atomically and reload verifies; rerun returns IDEMPOTENT_FINALIZED_SUCCESS with unchanged head; partial, extra or divergent registry content stops ALPHA_FINALIZATION_CONFLICT
expected supportive lineage stops ALREADY_SATISFIED_EXISTING_ALPHA, conflicting or unverifiable registry stops EXISTING_ALPHA_CONFLICT, both with zero launches; protected AF1/H1 digests unchanged
no qualification, gate, WP170/WP172/WP173, paper, execution, live, OMS, risk, credential, scheduler or repo Polymarket product API module is imported or reachable
a validated run with api_call_count greater than one succeeds and reports the count; reported cost above USD 5 or unavailable cost is RUNTIME_FAILURE
project status and status fragment state Phase-A or the one closed post-runtime terminal honestly and unlock S10-QUAL-REAL-01 only on a verified supportive leaf
repo truth index lists the contract, operator and status fragment and does not claim qualification, edge, profitability or paper/live readiness
